newsitem.title: USA: Strober consummates merger, goes private.
newsitem.headline: Strober consummates merger, goes private.

text.p: The Strober Organization Inc said Thursday that its stockholders had approved the merger with Hamilton NY Acquisition Corp, which was consummated today.
Strober said it is now a wholly-owned, closely held subsidiary of Hamilton Acquisition LLC a Delaware limited liability company.
Each outstanding share of Strober common stock was converted in the merger into the right to receive $6.00, cash. Strober's common stock is no longer publicly traded.
The company said its headquarters will remain in Brooklyn, New York.
Strober is a leading supplier of building materials to professional contractors.
